high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a solid purple background. The individual is wearing a sparkling, sequined skirt that reaches just above the knees. The skirt has a gradient of colors, predominantly blue with hints of silver and possibly some other shades, giving it a shimmering effect. The top part of the outfit appears to be a bikini-style top with thin straps, which is also adorned with sequins, matching the skirt. The person's posture is relaxed yet confident, with one hand resting on their hip and the other slightly bent at the elbow.
